rule: Opening is a chain of timed cards (startup: book, title 5 s, quote 5 s, scroll, story 13/13/10 s; New Game: scroll, nine 5 s intro cards, then creation). Any performed input skips the current cinematic. Creation ends in a dream text cinematic, then the game world. Death shows a good-variant dream card and then a New Game handler that clears the session. Exhaustion is a pop-up: fatal only when swimming or outdoors at night, otherwise rest one hour. Level-up waits for no enemies near, plays a fanfare, shows a pop-up, then applies health and opens the level-up screen. Exit from the start dungeon's top floor puts the player in a random location of the race's home province.

Dream-card framing for a loss, presentation only
